gap: No result ChatGPT got gives a timed switch for an HDMI KVM. The only timed figures I could open come from one AnandTech forum user: their Ugreen HDMI KVM showed a black screen for 5 s one way and 7 s the other, and a GREATHTEK KVM that replaced it switched both PCs in about 2.5 s.
standout_why: I opened deskdna.com (Sept 2026), dockgearhq.com/blog/best-kvm-switches-with-hdmi-2026 (2026-10-13) and thetechsearch.com/best-kvm-switches-2026 (2026-10-16). None names who measured anything. DeskDNA has one unattributed line saying its UGREEN USB-only sharing switch moves peripherals in 'about a second'. Dock Gear HQ and The Tech Search repeat spec-sheet figures only: 5 Gbps USB, 4K60 / 1440p120 / 1080p240, a 7.5 W charge port. So a timed switching delay would be new. The problem is the source: one forum user, not a lab, on an unnamed Ugreen model. That is too weak to anchor the page. thisusb.com would not load (certificate error), so I did not check it.
decides: It does not decide the pick. No lab or named publication (RTINGS, Notebookcheck, Tom's Hardware, ServeTheHome, Igor's Lab, Wirecutter) has published switch-time, latency, USB-throughput or power-draw figures for UGREEN CM664/15707, TESmart HKS201-P23, TESmart HDK202-M24 or CKL 922HUA-3. The forum report only backs a caution: on a cheap HDMI KVM, expect seconds of black screen while the HDMI handshake completes, and it can differ by direction. A named-measurement table cannot rank these candidates. The pick has to rest on specs (EDID emulation, HDMI 2.0 vs 2.1, USB 3.0) and on price.
candidates: UGREEN CM664 (15707) HDMI KVM 2 PCs 1 monitor 4K60
TESmart HKS201-P23 2-port HDMI KVM 4K60 USB 3.0 dock
TESmart HDK202-M24 HDMI 2.1 dual 4K144 KVM gaming dock

findings.product: Ugreen HDMI KVM (model not stated by poster)
findings.label: Black-screen time when switching computers
findings.value: 5 s (Win10 PC to Win11 PC); 7 s (Win11 PC to Win10 PC)
findings.note: Original post by user 'Skyzoomer', 19 Dec 2024. Timed by the user on one unit, not in a lab. The poster thought the HDMI handshake caused the delay. The thread never names the Ugreen model, so this cannot be pinned to the CM664/15707.

findings.label: Switching time, both PCs
findings.note: Same user, 'Skyzoomer', 6 Feb 2025, after replacing the Ugreen. Quote: 'Switches both PCs in about 2.5 seconds.' A user observation on the same PCs and monitor as the Ugreen figure, so the two are a rough side-by-side, not a controlled test.

unsourced: Lab-measured switching time for UGREEN CM664/15707, TESmart HKS201-P23, TESmart HDK202-M24 and CKL 922HUA-3. Searched Tom's Hardware, TechRadar, Notebookcheck (it has Ugreen deal/news posts only), ServeTheHome, PCWorld, How-To Geek, XDA, Igor's Lab (it has a Level1Techs DisplayPort KVM test, which is not HDMI and not a candidate), KitGuru and Club386. Found none.
Added input or video latency in ms for any candidate. PCWorld says only 'a few milliseconds' in general, and TESmart and BZBGear give vendor claims with no figure.
USB 3.0 throughput through any candidate KVM (CrystalDiskMark or similar). No named reviewer published one.
Measured power draw at the wall for any candidate. Listings give only power-supply ratings (e.g. 24 W or 36 W), not measured draw.

Achieved refresh rate or VRR behaviour through the TESmart HDK202-M24 / HKS202-M24 at 4K 144 Hz. I found only TESmart's own blog pages and YouTube unboxing or review videos whose findings I could not open as text.

The Phonograph's TESmart HCK0401A1U review (reported in search snippets as a 2 s video blackout with instant keyboard and mouse) and the DPReview 'KVM switch delays' thread (reported as about 2.5 s with an EDID emulator) both returned HTTP 403, so I left those figures out.
